headlines.title: PDD (PDD) Grew Revenue 8% but GAAP Net Income Fell 12%. Are Merchant Investments Producing Enough Growth?
headlines.summary: PDD Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:PDD) reported second-quarter revenue of RMB112.4 billion, up 8% year over year but below the RMB116.35 billion consensus estimate. GAAP net income attributable to ordinary shareholders declined 12% to RMB27.2 billion, while total operating expenses increased 13% to RMB36.6 billion. Shares gained approximately 3% in premarket trading following the results.

headlines.title: China E-Commerce Stocks Sink While Baidu Climbs 4%: Alibaba Falls 4%, PDD Holdings Declines 3%
headlines.summary: China's biggest internet stocks are moving in opposite directions Thursday, and the split points to a fault line running straight through the group that could reshape how investors position across the entire sector.

headlines.title: PDD Beat Earnings—So Why Did the Stock Still Fall?
headlines.summary: PDD Holdings beat earnings estimates but missed on revenue, with net income falling as spending on subsidies and AI rises, leaving shares lower despite the profit beat.

headlines.title: Did PDD’s Higher Q2 Sales but Lower Profitability Just Shift PDD Holdings’ (PDD) Investment Narrative?
headlines.summary: PDD Holdings reported its Q2 2026 results, with sales rising to CNY 112,358 million from CNY 103,985 million a year earlier, while net income fell to CNY 27,182 million from CNY 30,754 million as earnings per share declined on both a basic and diluted basis.

headlines.summary: PDD Holdings Inc (PDD) reports 8% revenue increase to RMB112.4 billion, but net income declines 12% as the company prioritizes long-term ecosystem building and navigates EU customs changes.

description: PDD Holdings Inc., a multinational commerce group that owns and operates a portfolio of businesses. The company operates Pinduoduo platform, which provides various product categories and interactive shopping experiences; and Temu, an online platform, which enables merchants to streamline their manufacturing and commercial operations. The company was formerly known as Pinduoduo Inc. and changed its name to PDD Holdings Inc. in February 2023. PDD Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
